name: hexographer-obsidian
description: Hex map paint plugin for Obsidian vaults — biomes, roads, labels

scripts.build: node scripts/check-core-boundary.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.core.json --noEmit && tsc -noEmit -skipLibCheck && node esbuild.config.mjs production
scripts.test: node scripts/check-core-boundary.mjs --self-test && node scripts/check-core-boundary.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.core.json --noEmit && vitest run
scripts.version: node version-bump.mjs && git add manifest.json versions.json

author: Jim Bohan
